raw_sections.summary:
PROFILE
Senior Operations & Compliance Leader with 19 years of expertise driving operational excellence, KYC/AML governance, and launch readiness across global financial institutions.
Proven track record of embedding scalable processes, managing cross-functional migrations, and ensuring first-line teams are equipped to execute with confidence.
raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
Assistant Vice President   ·   JPMorgan Chase   ·   Sep 2022 – Mar 2026
Led lending operations across commercial and corporate portfolios, maintaining compliance and operational excellence through evolving regulatory environments.
Owned launch and migration readiness for AI/ML-driven workflow improvements, delivering 35% efficiency gains and measurably reduced turnaround time.
Strengthened first-line controls through root cause analysis and governance standardisation, ensuring scalable audit-ready operations.
Managed cross-functional stakeholder alignment across Product, Tech, and Business teams to embed process changes into business-as-usual operations.
Operations Manager   ·   HSBC   ·   May 2021 – Sep 2022
Managed pre- and post-approval credit operations ensuring adherence to risk and compliance standards; supported SOX reviews, audits, and governance initiatives.
Team Leader   ·   IKEA   ·   May 2018 – May 2021
Led operational execution, process optimisation, and end-to-end service delivery, maintaining performance visibility across multiple workstreams.
Team Manager   ·   Amazon   ·   Oct 2016 – Apr 2018
Managed high-velocity operations, resource planning, and cross-functional performance tracking in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
Assistant Manager   ·   HSBC   ·   Oct 2006 – Oct 2016
Managed end-to-end KYC QC and onboarding for complex client structures (UBOs, SOW, SOF) as ultimate sign-off authority; zero non-compliance findings across all audit cycles.
Investigated high-value transactions and managed AML escalations; bridged Front Office, Middle Office, and Compliance to resolve documentation gaps in real time.
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
Designed and executed a Lean Six Sigma reengineering initiative eliminating structural waste, delivering £110,000 in sustainable annual cost savings.
Drove 35% improvement in operational efficiency by leading the design and implementation of AI/ML-powered automation across key workflows.
Achieved zero non-compliance findings across all audit cycles (internal, external, CCOR) during 10-year HSBC tenure.
